cloud.text: Clouds are tiny drops of water and ice floating in the air. They are a tricky mix!

fog.text: Fog is tiny water drops floating in the air near the ground. It is a tricky mix!

mist.text: Mist is tiny water drops floating in the air. It is a tricky mix!

smoke.text: Smoke is tiny solid bits and hot gas mixed together. It is a tricky mix!

foam.text: Foam is gas bubbles trapped inside a liquid or solid. It is a tricky mix!

jelly.text: Jelly is mostly water held in a wobbly solid. It is a tricky one!

slime.text: Slime flows slowly like a liquid but holds together like a solid. Tricky!

toothpaste.text: Toothpaste is thick. It flows when you squeeze it but keeps its shape. Tricky!

ghee.text: Ghee is solid when cool and turns liquid when warm. It depends on the temperature!

curd.text: Curd is thick and soft. It is hard to say, so ask your teacher!

dough.text: Dough is soft and sticky. It is hard to say, so ask your teacher!

fire.text: Fire is not a solid, liquid or gas. It is hot glowing gas and burning stuff. Tricky!

flame.text: A flame is not a solid, liquid or gas. It is hot glowing gas. Tricky!

light.text: Light is not matter at all. It is energy, so it is not a solid, liquid or gas!

sound.text: Sound is not matter. It is energy that travels, so it is not a solid, liquid or gas!

shadow.text: A shadow is not matter. It is just a place where light is blocked!
